author: cburgmer

english.text: Thanks!

jyutping: m4 goi1 saai3！
text: 唔該晒！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please give us some examples.

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 geoi2 gei2 go3 lai6 zi2 aa3？
text: 可唔可以舉幾個例子呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.

jyutping: jyut6 kau4 biu2 min6 mou5 hung1 hei3，so2 ji5 mou5 fung1，jik6 dou1 mou5 sing1 jam1。
text: 月球表面冇空氣，所以冇風，亦都冇聲音。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The sales are slipping.

jyutping: di1 siu1 sau6 leot6 dit3 dou3 hou2 sai1 lei6。
text: 啲銷售率跌到好犀利。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That young man can't get the sort of jobs he wants and doesn't have any friends; he's really at a loss.

jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 jau6 wan2 m4 dou3 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3 ge3 gung1，jau6 jat1 go3 pang4 jau5 dou1 mou5；keoi5 zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2。
text: 嗰個後生仔又搵唔到自己鍾意嘅工，又一個朋友都冇；佢真係唔知點算好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where's my book?

jyutping: ngo5 bun2 syu1 heoi3 zo2 bin1 aa3？
text: 我本書去咗邊呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't go out in this heat with a bare head.

jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 jit6，jiu3 daai3 faan1 deng2 mou2 sin1 hou2 ceot1 gaai1 aa3。
text: 天氣咁熱，要戴返頂帽先好出街呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Would you like your ears to show?

jyutping: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 lou6 zek3 ji5 zai2 ceot1 lai4 aa3？
text: 你想唔想露隻耳仔出嚟呀？

author: kaenif

english.text: Your birthday is drawing near.

jyutping: nei5 saang1 jat6 zau6 dou3 laa1 bo3。
text: 你生日就到啦噃。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He asked me a question.

jyutping: keoi5 man6 zo2 ngo5 jat1 tiu4 man6 tai4。
text: 佢問咗我一條問題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This movie is suitable for children.

jyutping: ne1 tou3 din6 jing2 ngaam1 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2。
text: 呢套電影啱小朋友睇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Could you please turn your television down?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 bou6 din6 si6 gaau3 sai3 seng1 siu2 siu2 aa3？
text: 可唔可以將部電視較細聲少少呀？

author: fercheung

english.text: What time do you go home?

jyutping: nei5 gei2 si4 faan1 uk1 kei2 aa3？
text: 你幾時返屋企呀？

author: kaenif

english.text: I am terribly hungry.

jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tou5 ngo6。
text: 我真係好肚餓。

author: kaenif

english.text: I am a member of the tennis club.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 mong5 kau4 keoi1 lok6 bou6 ge3 wui2 jyun4。
text: 我係網球俱樂部嘅會員。

author: kaenif

english.text: Your daughter isn't a girl anymore.

jyutping: nei5 go3 neoi5 m4 hai6 neoi2 zai2 laa3。
text: 你個女唔係女仔喇。

author: kaenif

english.text: I don't have time to eat right now.

jyutping: ngo5 ji1 gaa1 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6 je5。
text: 我依家冇時間食嘢。

author: kaenif

english.text: I stayed home last night to be able to receive your call.

jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 dang2 teng1 nei5 din6 waa2。
text: 我尋晚留喺屋企等聽你電話。

author: nickyeow

english.text: One after another they stood up and went out.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 go3 jau6 jat1 go3 gam2 kei5 zo2 hei2 san1，haang4 zo2 ceot1 heoi3。
text: 佢哋一個又一個噉企咗起身，行咗出去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I was just going to call you.

jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 nam2 zyu6 daa2 bei2 nei5。
text: 我啱啱諗住打俾你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I like playing the piano.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 taan4 kam4。
text: 我好鍾意彈琴。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm a biology major.

jyutping: ngo5 zyu2 sau1 sang1 mat6。
text: 我主修生物。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This piano has probably not been tuned for years.

jyutping: ne1 bou6 kam4 jing1 goi1 dou1 hou2 do1 nin4 mou5 tiu4 gwo3 jam1 laa3。
text: 呢部琴應該都好多年冇調過音喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You didn't show up.

jyutping: nei5 mou5 ceot1 jin6。
text: 你冇出現。

author: nickyeow

english.text: For one reason or another, their holiday in France wasn't as good as they expected it would be.

jyutping: jan1 wai6 gok3 zung2 jyun4 jan1，keoi5 dei6 hai2 faat3 gwok3 mou5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 waan2 dak1 gam3 hoi1 sam1。
text: 因為各種原因，佢哋喺法國冇想像中玩得咁開心。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I just need this. I don't need anything else.

jyutping: ngo5 jau5 ni1 go3 zau6 gau3 laa3，m4 sai2 kei4 taa1 je5。
text: 我有呢個就夠喇，唔使其他嘢。

english.text: And he said to us: Hereby shall I know that you are peaceable men: Leave one of your brethren with me, and take ye necessary provision for your houses, and go your ways, and bring your youngest brother to me, that I may know you are not spies: and you may receive this man again, that is kept in prison: and afterwards may have leave to buy what you will.

jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 gong2：ngo5 hai2 ni1 dou6 zi1 dou3 nei5 dei6 hai6 wo4 ping4 ge3 jan4：lau4 dai1 nei5 dei6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 hing1 dai6 tung4 maai4 ngo5 jat1 cai4，lo2 nei5 dei6 uk1 kei2 so2 seoi1 ge3 loeng4 sik6，haang4 nei5 dei6 ge3 lou6，daai2 nei5 dei6 sai3 lou2 lai4 ngo5 dou6，dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 zi1 dou3 nei5 dei6 m4 hai6 gaan3 dip6：nei5 dei6 ho2 nang4 wui5 zoi3 ci3 zip3 doi6 ni1 go3 bei6 cau4 gam3 ge3 jan4，zi1 hau6 nei5 dei6 ho2 nang4 wui5 fong3 gaa3 heoi3 maai5 nei5 dei6 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5。
text: 佢對我哋講：我喺呢度知道你哋係和平嘅人：留低你哋其中一個兄弟同埋我一齊，攞你哋屋企所需嘅糧食，行你哋嘅路，帶你哋細佬嚟我度，等我可以知道 你哋唔係間諜：你哋可能會再次接待呢個被囚禁嘅人，之後你哋可能會放假去買你哋想要嘅嘢。

english.text: His knowledge of Greek and Latin was singularly exact. He was deeply read in modern literature; and his surprising memory enabled him to display to the utmost advantage the various and carefully stored treasures of his mind. But though his erudition might have enabled him to have edited with accuracy the most obscure work in the whole range of ancient literature, his imagination would not have yielded him five lines of poetry.

jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 hei1 laap6 man4 tung4 laai1 ding1 man2 ge3 jing6 sik1 fei1 soeng4 zeon2 kok3。 keoi5 hai2 jin6 doi6 man4 hok6 jap6 min6 bei6 sam1 jap6 jyut6 duk6；ji4 keoi5 ge3 ging1 jan4 gei3 jik1 lik6 ling6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 zeoi3 daai6 cing4 dou6 gam2 zin2 si6 keoi5 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6 gok3 zung2 tung4 maai4 zing1 sam1 cyu5 cyun4 ge3 bou2 zong6。 daan6 seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ge3 hok6 sik1 ho2 nang4 ling6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 zeon2 kok3 gam2 pin1 cap1 ceot1 zing2 go3 gu2 doi6 man4 hok6 jap6 min6 zeoi3 mou4 wu4 ge3 zok3 ban2，daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 bing6 m4 wui6 ling6 keoi5 jau5 ng5 hang4 si1。
text: 佢對希臘文同拉丁文嘅認識非常準確。 佢喺現代文學入面被深入閱讀；而佢嘅驚人記憶力令佢可以最大程度噉展示佢腦海入面各種同埋精心儲存嘅寶藏。 但雖然佢嘅學識可能令佢可以準確噉編輯出整個古代文學入面最模糊嘅作品，但係佢嘅想像力並唔會令佢有五行詩。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 27th of June of 2013. The Blue Dreams are plural. The Blue Dreams are many. Interlingua is not the only one. For decades now, there have existed other Latinate conlangs, different projects. And in the future, some hope for others. But it has been the Green Dream, Esperanto, that has succeeded for more than a century. Reforms attempted upon Esperanto have met with failure over the decades because genuine Esperanto has an artistic balance with which one cannot tamper. Esperanto remains enduring. Amongst the Blues, my vote is still Interlingua. More people should give it a chance. Esperanto's accents give a charm to the language that perhaps boosted its survival over the years. There are substitute systems.

jyutping: hai2 2013 nin4 6 jyut6 27 hou6。laam4 sik1 mung6 soeng2 hai6 fuk1 sou3。laam4 sik1 mung6 soeng2 hou2 do1。gwok3 zai3 jyu5 jin4 m4 hai6 wai4 jat1 jat1 go3。gei2 sap6 nin4 lai4，zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 laai1 ding1 man2 ge3 conlang ，m4 tung4 ge3 hong6 muk6。ji4 hai2 zoeng1 loi4，jau5 di1 hei1 mong6 deoi3 kei4 taa1 jan4。daan6 hai6 sing4 gung1 zo2 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 go3 sai3 gei2 ge3，zau6 hai6 luk6 sik1 mung6 soeng2，sai3 gaai3 jyu5。gei2 sap6 nin4 lai4，soeng4 si3 deoi3 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 ge3 goi2 gaak3 dou1 sat1 baai6 zo2，jan1 wai6 zan1 zing3 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 jau5 jat1 zung2 ngai6 seot6 ping4 hang4，jan4 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 saan3 goi2。sai3 gaai3 jyu5 jing4 jin4 hai6 ci4 gau2 ge3。hai2 baan1 laam4 si1 jap6 min6，ngo5 ge3 piu3 jing4 jin4 hai6 gwok3 zai3 jyu5 jin4。jing1 goi1 do1 di1 jan4 bei2 go3 gei1 wui6 keoi5。sai3 gaai3 jyu5 ge3 hau2 jam1 ling6 dou3 ni1 zung2 jyu5 jin4 jau5 mei6 lik6，ho2 nang4 hai6 do1 nin4 lai4 cuk1 zeon3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 sang1 cyun4。jau5 tai3 doi6 hai6 tung2。
text: 喺2013年6月27號。藍色夢想係複數。藍色夢想好多。國際語言唔係唯一一個。幾十年嚟，仲有其他拉丁文嘅 conlang ，唔同嘅項目。而喺將來，有啲希望對其他人。但係成功咗超過一個世紀嘅，就係綠色夢想，世界語。幾十年嚟，嘗試對世界語嘅改革都失敗咗，因為真正嘅世界語有一種藝術平衡，人哋唔可以篡改。世界語仍然係持久嘅。喺班藍絲入面，我嘅票仍然係國際語言。應該多啲人畀個機會佢。世界語嘅口音令到呢種語言有魅力，可能係多年嚟促進咗佢嘅生存。有替代系統。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Extraterrestrials could be seen as gods if their powers dazzle us, but they’d differ from an immanent or transcendent God by being finite, physical beings within the universe, not its root. A hierarchy of beings—us, them, and beyond—fits both religious and speculative frameworks, potentially stretching from the mundane to the near-divine. Whether there’s an ultimate God atop it all, or just an endless progression of "higher" entities, depends on your worldview. What do you think—does the idea of a cosmic pecking order resonate with you, or do you lean toward a singular divine capstone?

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 dei6 ngoi6 saang1 mat6 ge3 lik6 loeng6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6，keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bei6 si6 wai4 san4，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 tung4 noi6 zoi6 waak6 ciu1 jyut6 ge3 san4 m4 tung4，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 hai6 jyu5 zau6 jap6 min6 jau5 haan6 ge3 mat6 lei5 cyun4 zoi6，ji4 m4 hai6 jyu5 zau6 ge3 gan1 jyun4。jat1 go3 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 gaai1 cang4 —— ngo5 dei6、keoi5 dei6 tung4 maai4 gang3 jyun5 ge3 cyun4 zoi6 —— sik1 hap6 zung1 gaau3 tung4 tau4 gei1 ge3 kwaang1 gaa2，jau5 ho2 nang4 jau4 sai3 zuk6 jin4 san1 dou3 gan6 fu4 san4 sing3。hai2 nei1 jat1 cai3 zi1 soeng6，gau3 ging2 jau5 mou5 jat1 go3 zung1 gik6 ge3 san4，ding6 hai6 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 mou4 kung4 mou4 zeon6 ge3「gang3 gou1」sat6 tai2，dou1 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 nei5 ge3 sai3 gaai3 gun1。nei5 dim2 tai2 — jyu5 zau6 doek3 sik6 dit6 zeoi6 ge3 soeng2 faat3 tung4 nei5 jau5 gung6 ming4，ding6 hai6 nei5 king1 hoeng3 jyu1 daan1 jat1 ge3 san4 sing3 ding2 fung1？
text: 如果地外生物嘅力量令我哋眼花繚亂，佢哋可以被視為神，但係佢哋同內在或超越嘅神唔同，因為佢哋係宇宙入面有限嘅物理存在，而唔係宇宙嘅根源。一個存在嘅階層 —— 我哋、佢哋同埋更遠嘅存在 —— 適合宗教同投機嘅框架，有可能由世俗延伸到近乎神聖。喺呢一切之上，究竟有冇一個終極嘅神，定係只係一個無窮無盡嘅「更高」實體，都取決於你嘅世界觀。你點睇 — 宇宙啄食秩序嘅想法同你有共鳴，定係你傾向於單一嘅神聖頂峰？
